run_order: original case order 0..59; each case baseline/add_shaker/add_reader
unit_and_descriptive_analysis: Units: seconds (wall clock, makespan), CNY (cost), samples/hour (throughput). Descriptive only: per-scenario/load counts and paired within-case reductions where baseline and scenario are jointly valid; no inferential statistics.
cloning_limitation: add_shaker/add_reader are hypothetical scalar-resource clones of demo:ks4000:1 and device:67 with identical properties and layout coordinates offset by [0.6,0] / [0,0.6]. They are not live installations; geometry/transport effects are modelled, not measured.
procurement_roi: Not assessed: no procurement cost, lead time or ROI analysis is performed.
budget_note: The same --budget solver time limit applies to every run and scenario.
scorer: benchmarks/v2/scorer.py independent arithmetic scorer + states audit
